sections.h2: Authorised plants reached 119 across seven notifications, a steady rollout

chart.title: Cumulative authorised plants rose steadily, not in an accelerating curve
chart.sub: Cumulative plants authorised for bulk sale, after each Gazette notification.
chart.source: Gazette notifications I-VII, Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Nov 2023-Feb 2026.

sections.means: Each authorisation lasts three years from its Gazette date, so the first cohort comes up for renewal in November 2026.
sections.todo: Watch the November 2026 renewals to see whether the programme is treated as a going concern or lapses plant by plant.

sections.h2: Uttar Pradesh holds 28 plants, and the top six states about 70 per cent

sections.means: Plant siting follows agricultural and dairy feedstock, which leaves the bio-fertiliser base concentrated in a few states.
sections.todo: Route the bulk-sale programme toward the states that have the plants and the degraded land, not only the largest feedstock pools.

sections.h2: Only 13% of rated CBG capacity was used, so running plants is the bottleneck
